name: cloudcodex-environment-discovery
description: Read-only independent Codex Legacy and Current discovery. Current direct Configuration-ID GET available; Current live catalog and detail currently blocked by backend authentication and awaiting supported access.

interface.longDescription: Read-only discovery of existing Codex Cloud environments. Legacy discovery operational. Current catalog and exact Configuration-ID GET implemented, but Current live reads remain on hold awaiting supported authorized API access (401 JSON/403 challenge observed). GitHub and onboarding candidates remain indirect. Independent skills, optional MCP, no provisioning or credential extraction.
interface.defaultPrompt: Determine the requested Codex Cloud type first. For Legacy invoke $legacy-discovery; for current-generation Cloud invoke $current-discovery. If both are explicitly requested, invoke the two skills separately and report separate provider statuses; do not produce an implicit mixed catalog. Read-only: no task or environment creation. On Current 401/403 report the actual denial and mark live Current discovery pending; never infer an empty catalog or switch identities.
